content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Academic Associate: Master's degree (M.E./M.Tech./MCA/MA/MSc./M.Phil./MBA) with consistently strong academic performance in Education, Management, Public Policy, Psychology, Sociology, Economics, Political Science, Higher Education, Engineering, Data Science, or related disciplines. Professor of Practice: Doctoral degree or Postgraduate/professional qualification with 15-20 years experience as per category (Academic Leaders, Business/Industry Leaders, Government/Public Service Leaders, Social Sector/Public Policy Leaders).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BITS Pilani Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BITS Pilani to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Academic Associate / Professor of Practice posts at BITS Pilani is 12th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026. These positions are for Academic Associate and Professor of Practice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Academic Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Academic Associate position, candidates must possess a Master's degree (M.E./M.Tech./MCA/MA/MSc./M.Phil./MBA) with a strong academic record in relevant disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the experience required for the Professor of Practice post?
faq.answer: The Professor of Practice role requires a Doctoral degree or Postgraduate/professional qualification with 15-20 years of experience, depending on the specific leadership category.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Academic Associate post is Rs. 50,000/- per month, and for the Professor of Practice, it is Rs. 2,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes initial screening, departmental review and shortlisting, followed by an interview, and finally, final approval.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article or directly from the BITS Pilani official website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for contractual positions at BITS Pilani.
